description: List the labels of a project's tasks (projectId) or of a pipeline's opportunities (pipelineId, plus workspaceId outside your personal workspace) in the connected LoopGantt ACCOUNT (requires signing in to LoopGantt, or an API key): each label with a look (symbol, tone, form), where that look is defined (workspace, project or pipeline) and how many items carry it, then the plain labels in use. Read-only: labels and their looks are set up in the app's Labels settings, never through this API. To label an item, pass labels to create_task / update_task or to the pipeline opportunity tools.

pipelineId.description: Pipeline id from pipeline_list_pipelines (its opportunities' labels)

projectId.description: Project id from list_projects (its tasks' labels)

workspaceId.description: With pipelineId: the workspace id. Omit for your personal workspace.

name: list_labels
